html:
SMTO-CFG-0091 — This permission question is out of date

GUID: 02d72021-f7c6-5f93-b81a-543250d7bd0f
Slug: capability-activation-grant-stale
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_activation

What happened

  • You answered a Skill permission question that no longer matches the task, for example because the request changed or the question was already answered elsewhere. Your answer wasn't saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page in your browser, then scroll to the task. Reloading shows the question SMTO is waiting on now, not the old copy your screen was still showing.
  2. If a permission question is still showing, answer it again with Allow for this conversation (or Allow for this task) or Don't allow. A fresh answer is matched to the current question, so SMTO can accept it.
  3. If no question is showing, look at the task's latest activity. If it already moved on, there is nothing left to answer. The question may have been answered in another window, or the agent may ask again later if it still needs the Skill.
  4. Answer permission questions from one window or device at a time. Once one window answers, the same question in any other window becomes out of date.

What success looks like

  • Your answer is accepted, the question disappears and the task continues.

If it still fails

  • If the same message keeps appearing after reloading, select Copy error details in this panel and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't send a new message just to bring the question back; that changes the request you're answering for.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The capability grant answer was rejected because it no longer matches the pending interaction (operation ID, grant_request_id, task source digest, authority digest, conversation, a newer amendment, or an already resumed or answered state).

What this means

  • Grant answer/continuation does not match the prompted operation, grant ID, task/authority digest, conversation or current pending state, including intervening amendments. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Grant answer/continuation does not match the prompted operation, grant ID, task/authority digest, conversation or current pending state, including intervening amendments.

How to diagnose it

  • Refresh current interaction identity and retained grant state; do not reuse an approval for changed task intent.

How to fix it

  • Reload the run's current pending_wait and capability_grants state and resubmit the decision with the current operation_id and capability_grant_request_id. Do not reuse an approval across an amendment or a changed task source; if the grant is no longer in the prompted state, let the agent request a new grant.
  • This capability question is stale. Refresh the current interaction.

Retry and execution caution

  • The reported capability or interaction condition changes.

How to verify the fix

  • A response matches the current runtime-issued interaction and authority snapshot.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass frozen authority, operation permissions or credential requirements.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
